items.information:
🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2025!** 🟥🟨🟩
Este año celebramos con orgullo el décimo aniversario desde las primeras competencias oficiales en Bolivia, que dieron inicio a nuestra comunidad. Desde entonces, el cubo ha unido a personas de todas las edades y rincones del país, creciendo hasta convertirse en la gran comunidad que tenemos hoy.
La inscripción está abierta para todas las personas, sin importar edad ni lugar de origen. ¡Ven y sé parte de este evento histórico que marcará un antes y un después en Bolivia!


🟥🟨🟩 **Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2025!** 🟥🟨🟩
This year we proudly celebrate the tenth anniversary since the first official competitions in Bolivia, which marked the beginning of our community. Since then, the cube has united people of all ages and from every corner of the country, growing into the great community we have today.
Registration is open to everyone, regardless of age or origin. Be part of this historic event that will mark a before and after in Bolivia!

###### Español
Nos enorgullece presentar el Mexican Championship 2025.
Será el tercer Campeonato Nacional en México: una celebración de habilidad, velocidad y comunidad.

Estés donde estés, no te lo puedes perder.

Todos los competidores, incluyendo los extranjeros, podrán participar y avanzar hasta las rondas finales. Sin embargo, **las premiaciones estarán reservadas únicamente para los competidores de nacionalidad mexicana.**

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

###### English
We are proud to present the Mexican Championship 2025.
It will be the third National Championship in Mexico: a celebration of skill, speed, and community.

No matter where you are, you can’t miss it.

All competitors, including foreign participants, may compete and advance to the final rounds. However, **awards will be reserved exclusively for competitors of Mexican nationality.**

NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information:
Bem-vindo à Terceira competição de cubo mágico de Rondonópolis!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE4NTMxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6dd125c4b071efcf71b8385f06a5518ef7b69b4b/HiPaint_1755473542477.jpg)

**REGISTRO**

A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:

1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30 e o pagamento deverá ser feito via PIX para a chave 66999694243 (Allan Alves Furini Xavier). O comprovante de pagamento deverá ser enviado para o número em questão (WhatsApp).
2. Será cobrada uma taxa de R$10 por acompanhante que também deverá ser paga pela chave PIX informada.
3. Para informações adicionais, verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do WhatsApp ou e-mail informado.
4. Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.
5. Haverá competição de modalidades não oficiais: 3x3 debaixo d'água. Importante que aos competidores do embaixo d'água deverão trazer roupa de banho (bermuda ou maiô), óculos de mergulho e próprios cubos para a modalidade (quantidade que consiga montar sem respirar).
6. Acesse este link para entrar no grupo do WhatsApp para obter mais informações sobre o campeonato: https://chat.whatsapp.com/E1bkkzJDw8s4mEleyLljol 
---
Welcome to the third Rondonópolis Rubik's Cube Competition!

**REGISTRATION**

Participation in this competition requires the competitor to have knowledge of the following requirements:

1. Register through the WCA website. The registration fee will be R$ 30, and payment should be made via PIX to the account 66999694243 (Allan Alves Furini Xavier). The payment receipt should be sent to the same number (WhatsApp).
2. A fee of R$ 10 per guest will be charged, and this fee should also be paid through the provided PIX account.
3. For additional information, please check the WCA website or contact the organizer via WhatsApp or the provided email address.
4. Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.
5. There will be competitions for unofficial events: 3x3 underwater. It is important for competitors in the underwater event to bring swimwear (shorts or swimsuit), diving goggles, and their own cubes for the event (the number they can solve without breathing).
6. Click this link to join the WhatsApp group for more information about the championship: https://chat.whatsapp.com/E1bkkzJDw8s4mEleyLljol

items.information:
**(Português) Brasileiro**
É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara!

Esse ano, estamos testando pela primeira vez um dia apenas para modalidades silenciosas, e o segundo dia para as modalidades mais populares. Então pedimos para prestar bastante atenção às modalidades em que você está se inscrevendo.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.

**English**
It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara!

This year, we are testing for the first time one day exclusively to silent events, and the second day for the most popular events. Therefore, we ask you to pay a lot of attention to the events you are registering to.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA).

It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information:
***English version is below***

**Deutsch:**
Wir freuen uns sehr euch Linz Nikolaus Day 2025 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Simon Praschl, Oskar Schöpl und Lukas Schwarz und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Das Turnier findet im Volkshaus Ebelsberg statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

**English:**
We are happy to announce the Linz Nikolaus Day 2025 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Simon Praschl, Lukas Schwarz and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.
